nds-header-decides.reason: An encrypted secure area or a DSi unit code decides the files, not the game region.
nds-header-decides.title: NDS BIOS decided by header bytes, not region

melonds.note: The unit code decides the DSi set, not a region.

melonds_ds.note: The secure-area test refuses an encrypted retail cartridge without bios7.bin and bios9.bin. The unit code decides the DSi set.

nds-secure-area.description: The ARM9 ROM offset is the u32 at 0x20. A retail cartridge whose ARM9 area is still encrypted needs the real ARM7 and ARM9 BIOS. The area reads decrypted when the u32 at that offset is 0xE7FFDEFF and the u32 0x10 bytes later is not. Homebrew (ARM9 ROM offset under 0x4000, or game code '####') never needs them.

nds-unit-code.description: Unit code at 0x12. DSi-only titles need the DSi firmware set.
